items.text: Ladd McConkey (ribs) is the biggest Questionable on the slate; practiced limited Friday, game-time feel, 4pm ET start. Impacts Herbert and LAC pass game heavily.
items.why: Ribs from Week 1 exit; limited return Friday after DNP Wed/Thu.
items.implication: If out, Quentin Johnston/Harris volume spike and Herbert downgrade; monitor closely.
items.opportunity: Primary target/route leader; absence compresses LAC offense.

items.text: Nico Collins listed OUT (hamstring) for Sunday vs CIN after missing practices; Schefter and Rapoport confirmed the ruling.
items.why: Hamstring injury from Wednesday practice; history of multi-game absences on hammy.
items.implication: HOU WR room thins to Hutchinson/Boutte/Noel volume; Schultz TE bump; Stroud downgrade.
items.opportunity: Full routes previously (37 on 42 dropbacks); zero this week.

items.text: Zay Flowers (and Ja'Kobi Lane) OUT/DOUBTFUL (hamstring); limited Friday but expected to miss vs NO.
items.why: Missed Thu practice, limited Fri after Week 1 exit; Lane on IR/return (wrist).
items.implication: BAL WR crumbs: Bateman WR1, then Walker/Wester/Sarratt/Moore; Andrews target spike.

items.text: Brock Bowers DOUBTFUL (knee) vs LAC after limited Friday return from meniscus surgery; will test pregame.
items.why: Returned limited after missing early week; team plans pregame test.
items.implication: Prepare without; Mayer inherits targets/routes as primary TE.
items.opportunity: High prior route share expected to transfer if inactive.

items.text: Puka Nacua missed Friday practice (hip); Donald plans to play MNF vs NYG. Status pending Saturday.
items.why: New hip addition to report after full Thu; related to prior core/psoas issues possible.
items.implication: Monday uncertainty; have escape hatch (Adams/Atwell); start if active.
items.opportunity: Key target; absence elevates other LAR WRs.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson IN for 2026 debut; Patriots desperate for playmakers with AJ Brown IR. Potential 10+ touches vs Stevenson; strong upcoming schedule.
items.why: Ready to go per reports; NE needs explosives post-Brown IR; matchups favorable pre-bye.
items.implication: Committee risk but 10+ touch upside debut; Stevenson floor remains but share threatened.
items.opportunity: Unclear exact split yet; explosive role expansion possible.

items.text: Alvin Kamara IN; expected to squeeze Etienne/Miller committee further in NO@BAL pace-up game.
items.why: Cleared/active after absence; NO needs him.
items.implication: Etienne hate/downgrade as three-headed backfield; Kamara third-down/pass role.
items.opportunity: Etienne matched Miller rushes Week 1; Kamara return compresses all.

items.text: Joe Burrow listed QUESTIONABLE (back) but said he's playing; Bengals vs HOU.
items.why: Self-reported playing; coach positive; back injury.
items.implication: Start with confidence if active; CIN pass game intact vs thinned HOU secondary.

items.text: CMC gets usage bump off Week 1 regardless; Kaelon Black (groin) Q status matters for SF backfield share vs MIA.
items.why: Week 1 workload already elite; Black limited/Q could consolidate further.
items.implication: Elite RB1; monitor Black for any committee drip.

items.text: LOVE Kenneth Walker vs IND: 24%+ target share (tied lead), 74% snaps/21-of-24 RB touches through 3Q Week 1; IND gave 163 yds/3 TDs to Henry.
items.why: Elite utilization/pass-game role in first KC game; soft run matchup.
items.implication: RB1 upside; start with confidence as high-end RB2/1.
items.opportunity: 24% tgt share, high snap/touch rate, red-zone implied.

items.text: LOVE Ashton Jeanty @ LAC: 99 utilization score Week 1 (2nd only to Bijan), 19% tgt share recent, 25+ touches frequent.
items.why: Kubiak offense fully featured him; overreaction to prior injury scare.
items.implication: Strong RB2/flex with pass+run work vs soft LAC.

items.text: LOVE Bucky Irving vs CLE: 26% tgt share, all RB RZ touches, out-routed Gainwell; CLE soft vs run.
items.implication: Upside RB2/flex; clear lead back usage.
items.opportunity: 26% targets, 100% RZ RB work, route edge.

items.text: HATE Travis Etienne @ BAL: Matched Miller rushes Week 1, pass-heavy production; Kamara return squeezes role further as underdogs.
items.why: Committee dilution + negative script + Kamara IN.
items.opportunity: Split early downs; pass work at risk.

items.text: LOVE Justin Jefferson @ CHI: 37% tgt share from Wentz Week 1; 93 yds/18 PPG career avg with Wentz; Bears soft vs WRs.
